notes.title: Gauge Of Rage is Now Completely Free!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Gauge Of Rage was a passion project of mine for several years. Everything from the programming to the artwork to the music was done by me and a couple of friends over a span of over 3 years. Now that it's been online for a couple years and I've moved onto other things, I decided that I'm no longer concerned about making money from it. The old price served as a barrier which kept a lot of interested players out. I figured it was time to remove that barrier and allow anyone to have the game completely free, no strings attached. Hope you enjoy it!

Pay it forward :)

Dave
